##### Project general facts

Castleton at Central Park is a premium residential development within City Walk, combining contemporary architecture with lush greenery and a peaceful park setting. Offering a selection of 1-, 2-, 3-, and 4-bedroom apartments, the development features spacious and thoughtfully designed interiors that overlook the surrounding greenery and Dubai skyline. It also includes an exclusive two-storey penthouse with panoramic views of the park and the city, creating an exceptional urban living experience.

Residents can enjoy the unique lifestyle of Central Park at City Walk, with a private park offering abundant green spaces and opportunities for outdoor activities. The development is surrounded by a wide selection of restaurants, world-class hotels, shopping destinations, and leisure and entertainment facilities, creating a vibrant environment where everything needed for an active and convenient lifestyle is close at hand.

The residences feature modern finishing with high-quality materials and spacious layouts designed to maximise comfort and natural light. Contemporary interiors are complemented by carefully considered details and an inviting sense of space, while the kitchens are equipped. The residences are offered unfurnished.

##### Location description and benefits

Big city living is by definition a fast-paced lifestyle set amongst high rises and bright lights. It is almost a blessing when you get to take refuge in a green space, most of the time away from the concrete surroundings. But what if we could blur the lines between urban and nature? Central Park at City Walk brings both of these worlds together. Premium homes and lush green landscapes set in the heart of Dubai create a true park lifestyle community that will make you reimagine what the urban jungle is.

City Walk is a creative lifestyle space to live, work and play in the heart of Dubai. Conceptualised by world-renowned designers, this high-end destination includes international retail offerings, upscale gourmet restaurants, world-class residences, and luxurious hotels, combining Dubai’s love of out-of-the-box thinking with contemporary convenience. Built around movement, sharing, and community, the modern urban mix and easy connectivity make it one of the most prominent and recognisable neighbourhoods in Dubai.

Connected by a well-established road network, and located between Al Wasl Road and Sheikh Zayed Road, Central Park at City Walk is ideally placed for quick and convenient access to major landmarks in Dubai.
